frozen_rule_applied: A method is eligible only when both exact development answers preserve all claims and protected literals, contain no unsupported assertions, and are at least as readable as the baseline in both cases. Among eligible methods, prefer clarity gains across cases, then the simpler method. No repairs are allowed.

baseline.role: Reference arm, not a candidate method.

limitations: Selection establishes quality eligibility and resolves a procedural tie; it does not establish improved clarity or a detector benefit.
